challenge.heading: Challenge & Solution
challenge.label: Services we provided:
challenge.description: The goal was to build straightforward, professional and emotionally engaging presentations for colleagues and clients. We tailored each deck to its audience, aligned the material with the brand and improved the clarity of the message.

result.heading: The Result
result.label: Project outcomes:
result.feedback: GT Marketing brought the level of professionalism our presentations were missing. Management and HR were impressed, and the final product created a better experience for new employees and clients.
result.result: Ten presentations were created for Workiz, improving onboarding, supporting the sales team and making internal communication easier.
